hero_version_available: Ace Blocker 1.0 Alpha is now live
hero_description: The most powerful blocker designed to help you overcome internet addictions through intelligent site filtering and behavior-shaping scripts.
features_section_description: Simple to setup, impossible to ignore. Ace Blocker provides the tools you need to stay on track.
feature_blocks_description: Advanced network-level blocking that's difficult to bypass, ensuring you stay away from distractions when you need to most.
feature_scripts_description: Inject scripts that make addictive sites less visually appealing, breaking the dopamine loops that keep you scrolling.
feature_analytics_description: Visualize your progress and see exactly how much time you've reclaimed since starting your journey with Ace Blocker.
pro_subtitle: Upgrade to Ace Blocker Pro and unlock the full potential of your focus journey.
plan_free_description: Perfect for getting started with focus protection.
plan_pro_description: The ultimate toolset for total digital well-being.
about_hero_description: We didn't just build another blocker. We built an engine for behavioral change. Ace Blocker is designed to break the cycle of internet addiction at the source.
about_mission_description: Internet addiction isn't about a lack of willpower; it's about systems designed to exploit your biology. We build tools that fight back, giving you the upper hand in the battle for your attention.
about_tech_description: Under the hood, Ace Blocker uses a high-performance, system-wide proxy engine that ensures nothing slips through the cracks.
about_feature_system_description: Unlike simple browser extensions, Ace Blocker operates at the network level. This means it protects your entire system—apps, games, and every browser you use.
about_feature_intel_description: Our engine handles millions of site rules in real-time using high-performance database technology, allowing for instant filtering without slowing down your connection.
about_feature_scripts_description: Sometimes blocking isn't enough. Our 'Boredom Scripts' modify addictive sites to remove the triggers that hook you—like infinite scroll or manipulative UI—making the sites less appealing and more boring.
about_feature_locks_description: Set it and forget it—or try to. Our schedules can be locked with increasing levels of strictness, ensuring that when your willpower dips, your protection remains absolute.
